newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens stockbrokers meet to decide on trading.
newsitem.headline: Athens stockbrokers meet to decide on trading.

text.p: Athens stockbrokers met to discuss whether to resume trading after halting all transactions at the bourse last Friday because the exchange clearing house failed to pay some members.
Brokers from large and small trading houses gathered at the building of the Association of Athens Stock Exchange Members (SMEXA) about 90 minutes before the Monday session was to open.
Brokers entering the meeting expressed differing views as to whether the bourse should operate on Monday.
SMEXA members stopped all trade on Friday after the exchange clearing house failed on Thursday to pay cash settlements to several brokerages.

Several brokers said they had no confidence they would be paid by the clearing house unless the bourse acted quickly. They said their work stoppage had helped to put pressure on the government and bourse officials to act.

Bourse officials announced on Friday they were freezing the bank accounts and assets of Delta Securities, and sealing its offices and safe, after Delta was found to be in the red with the bourse clearing house for 2.6 billion drachmas.
A public prosecutor charged three senior officials of Delta Securities with fraud and banned them from leaving the country, court officials said.
Government spokesman Dimitris Reppas said the bourse must sort out its own problems.
